newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-REEVES PASSES PHYSICAL, NETS-MAVS BLOCKBUSTER IS OFFICIAL.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-REEVES PASSES PHYSICAL, NETS-MAVS BLOCKBUSTER IS OFFICIAL.

text.p: The blockbuster nine-player trade between the Dallas Mavericks and New Jersey Nets became official at last on Thursday.

Khalid Reeves, one of four players acquired Monday by the Mavericks from New Jersey, passed a physical Thursday morning, which the team required after he informed them in an interview on Wednesday he had a heart murmur as a child.
Upon learning of the ailment, the Mavericks held up the deal pending results of a physical and stress test.

The Nets sent centre Shawn Bradley, forward Ed O'Bannon and guards Robert Pack and Reeves to Dallas for All-Star forward Chris Gatling, guards Jimmy Jackson and Sam Cassell, swingman George McCloud and centre Eric Montross. All players had to pass physicals before the trade was finalised.
